overview: The board endorsed an Approval Not Required plan for 970 Fellsway and handled procedural continuances and withdrawals for other development projects.

items.title: 970 Fellsway ANR Plan
items.summary: Endorsed an Approval Not Required (ANR) plan to divide the existing lot into two parcels, separating a future residential development from the existing storage building.

items.title: 400 Mystic Ave Continuance
items.summary: Approved a request to continue the public hearing for special permits and site plan review to July 17, 2024.

items.title: 360 Salem Street Withdrawal
items.summary: Acknowledged the withdrawal of the special permit application, removing the item from the board's advisory review.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the meeting held on May 15, 2024.
